scenario_description:
Objective: Prevent an optional home blood-pressure log from becoming incomplete or unusable before the July 21 review.
Emerging Need: A general visit becomes a time-bound preparation task once cuff access, exercise timing, and an upload cutoff align around the last feasible start.
Decision Context: Saved primary-care guidance and the current cuff inventory determine whether borrowing is appropriate, when readings must begin, and how morning activity affects usable timing.
Consequence: If the preparation window is missed, the visit still occurs but may lack the practical home-reading context the clinic invited.

parameter.title: Primary care blood pressure review
parameter.description: Routine follow-up visit at Rose City Primary; preparation details to come.

parameter.subject: Optional home readings before July 21 visit
parameter.body: If you can access a home blood-pressure cuff, please bring or upload a recent home reading log before your July 21 review. The portal link will open later this week. Please do not buy equipment solely for this request.

parameter.content: I still have the validated upper-arm cuff I used after physical therapy; you're welcome to borrow it Tuesday evening through Monday, July 20 after your evening reading if it helps. It has fresh batteries.

parameter.title: Thursday sunrise mobility class
parameter.description: Outdoor mobility class after the waitlist cleared.

parameter.content: I can hand off the cuff in the lobby until 8:30 tonight; after that I leave for Eugene and won't be back until Friday evening.

parameter.subject: Home reading upload link for July 21 review
parameter.body: Your portal link for the July 21 blood pressure review is active. Please upload any home reading log you prepare by 8:00 AM Tuesday so the care team can attach it to the visit notes.
